lines.text: Host: Welcome back to Nine to Five.
Here today is Suzy Hawley.
We’re going to chat a bit about the countries that work the longest hours and how this is unhealthy.
It’s common knowledge that there is a global increase in the number of hours that people are working.
So, Suzy, which countries work the most?
Suzy: It’s really hard to say which countries work the most.
There is no doubt that there are countries that work more hours than others.
South Korea, for example works very long hours.
A couple of years ago they cut the working week from 68 hours to 52 hours.
But it didn’t change much because people still spent a lot of time at their desks.
And it’s still more than the 48 hours a week maximum that the ILO, the International Labour Organization, recommends.
Host: Is there an upper limit to how much time people can spend at work in different countries?
Suzy: Well, in many countries, like the UK, Brazil or Turkey, there’s a weekly limit on working time, but there are also countries that don’t have such a limit.
Other countries like Mexico also don’t have a limit – and Mexico is the country where people spend the most hours at work.
They also only get ten days of holiday a year, which is a very small amount.
There is no question, in my opinion, that too much time working can cause a lot of health problems, for example, if you have a desk job, you are sitting down all day.
And studies show that working long hours doesn’t improve work performance.
It increases your stress and makes you feel bad.
Host: What happens when we work too much?
What does sitting down all day do to your body?
Suzy: It creates long-term problems for your body.
You can develop a bad back or neck problems from sitting too much.
There are also more serious health problems.
Studies show that you are more likely to get heart disease and other illnesses.
When you work too much, you also start to make bad decisions, like eating fast food and not exercising.
Mental health problems like feeling unhappy are another issue.
Host: Not sleeping enough is also a problem, I guess.
Suzy: Absolutely.
It’s called ‘sleep deprivation’, and you feel tired all the time.
People need to work to pay bills, so they work more and more.
But their health suffers.
I think people could be more useful if they didn’t work long hours.
Everyone knows that when you are tired, you are more likely to have an accident.
Host: Whose responsibility is this?
Suzy: Good question!
Most people think that managers and bosses are responsible, but it’s the person’s responsibility, too.
We should all try to avoid working too much and take more time to eat well and do exercise.
We will all work better.
Host: Thanks, Suzy.
That’s all we have time for now, but tune in next week when we’ll be talking …

lines.text: I love it when the power stops working.
Why?
Well, it gives me a chance to see the night sky, something that fewer and fewer people see these days.
Hi everyone, and welcome to this week’s podcast.
I’m talking about a threat you might not know about: light pollution.
That is, the light from streetlights and houses that stop us from seeing the beautiful night sky.
The light bulb is one of the greatest things ever invented.
We all agree on that.
Can you imagine what life would be like without them?
By turning on a light switch, we have the power to turn the dark into light.
But this also causes problems.
More than 80 percent of the world’s population lives under skies that are polluted by light.
To put it another way, over 6 billion people live with light pollution.
In some places that have a lot of light pollution, like Singapore, there is so much light that you can only see 0.05 percent of the stars in the sky.
About 14% of the world’s population don’t even use their ability to see at night.
Some cities, like Las Vegas, are so bright that you can see their lights from over 65 kilometres away.
Light pollution might not be as serious as other issues, but it does cause problems for the environment.
It is bad for animals, like birds, that move a lot at night because it can make them go the wrong way.
Studies show that light pollution affects other species that don’t even live in the cities.
These include bats, fish, turtles and monkeys.
Every year, millions of baby sea turtles die because the lights make them confused and they can’t find the ocean, where they would be safe from other animals.
Light pollution also damages human health.
It doesn’t matter if it’s a computer screen or a streetlight shining through a window – too much light affects the natural light-dark cycle of day and night and upsets our biological clock.
In other words, we don’t know when to sleep and when to wake up.
This can damage our health by increasing the risk of heart disease, obesity and cancer.
It can also damage our mental health.
When we don’t sleep well, we get stressed.
So what can we do to keep healthy?
We can’t escape light pollution, but let me tell you a secret that may help a little – looking at the clear night sky is very relaxing!
It makes you feel like you are part of something bigger.
Well, that’s it for today.
Tune in next time when I’ll be …

lines.text: Hi everyone.
My presentation today is about two alternative and quite strange food festivals that take place around the world … but not in the way you might think.
I’m interested in these types of festivals because they are a strange way to celebrate food and are very popular.
Have you ever heard of the Night of the Radishes?
It’s a festival that takes place in my hometown, Oaxaca in southern Mexico, and it is over a century old.
For the festival, we decorate radishes, a vegetable that’s red on the outside and white on the inside, but we don’t eat them.
The festival takes place on the 23rd of December and seems to get more and more popular every year.
So, how did it begin?
Well, people working in markets wanted to attract shoppers to the town square, so they cut radishes into the shape of people or animals.
They were very popular, and in 1897, they decided to make it a festival, and that tradition lives on to this day.
The radishes are larger than normal and they are picked around the 18th of December.
Artists only have a few days to get their radishes ready, and the person who has the best radish wins a 12,000-peso prize.
The most amazing thing about this event is how popular it is.
People wait hours just to see the radishes.
The second festival I want to talk about is called La Tomatina.
This takes place in Spain in the small town of Buñol.
About nine thousand people live in the town, but during La Tomatina, thousands of tourists visit the region just to be part of the occasion.
So, what is it?
Well, it’s a huge food fight with tomatoes!
People believe La Tomatina started around 1945 when a large public food fight took place.
A celebration was taking place in the village with people dressed in giant heads.
Some young people made the big head of someone fall off and he got very angry.
He tried to run after the young people, but fell into a market stall selling tomatoes.
So, the man started throwing tomatoes at the young people.
Then, more people started to join in, and it turned into a huge tomato fight.
The people of Buñol enjoyed it so much that they did it again the next year.
It became a big festival in 1952.
What does the festival consist of?
On the day, big lorries filled with tomatoes arrive in the main square of the town.
How much tomato do you think they use for the fight?
[pause] 120,000 kilos!
The fight starts at 11 am, and it ends when someone fires a large gun, called a cannon.
These are just two of the many strange food festivals around the world.
They are strange because people don’t eat the food at these festivals, they use it to make things or throw it at each other.
But these festivals are enormous fun for all generations and are a great alternative for people looking for something different.

lines.text: Today I’m going to talk about an animal that has a great environmental impact – the beaver.
The beaver is similar to a rat, but it’s much bigger, with brown fur, sharp teeth and a long, flat tail.
You probably know them.
They’re famous for building dams, which are like walls across rivers that stop the water from moving.
I’m going to talk today about the benefits of working with these animals rather than against them.
Many people don’t realize that some wild animals can actually help us, but it’s true.
We depend on some animals as much as they depend on us.
Many people see beavers as a threat to our environment.
They make trouble wherever they go, they cut down trees and make rivers flood.
But personally, I don’t think that beavers are a problem at all.
It seems to me that we are just starting to realize how important they are.
When humans first met beavers hundreds of years ago, humans didn’t want to protect them, they wanted to kill them.
As a result, beavers almost died out.
A long time ago, they were very valuable.
The reason for this was that everyone wanted their fur in Europe and Asia, and later in North America, too.
People used beaver fur to make clothes, especially hats.
There were between 100 and 400 million beavers in North America before the Europeans arrived.
In the late 1800s, however, there were only 100,000.
The beaver had become endangered.
The result of this was that lots of animal habitats were lost.
Beavers build dams, which create wetlands – large areas of land covered in water.
These wetlands provide food and a home for the beaver, but they also provide homes for other animals, too.
Frogs, for example, live in wetlands created by beavers.
Fish also use these wetlands to take care of their young and ducks make their homes near them, too.
Wetlands keep carbon dioxide, a gas which makes the world’s temperature rise, out of the atmosphere, and this is good because it stops the rise in temperature around the world.
The other way that beavers are helping with the climate crisis is by stopping forest fires, which create a lot of pollution and a lot of damage.
Wetlands made by beavers stop fires from getting bigger, and they also provide protection for animals trying to escape the fires.
In England and Scotland, beavers have recently returned.
Britain is a very wet place and every year floods cause millions of pounds of damage.
Due to the dams that beavers make, flood damage is reduced because the water from floods goes to the wetlands instead.
Beavers help reduce floodwater by up to 30%.
To sum up, beavers are helping us to solve some serious environmental problems.
We just have to let nature’s engineers get on with their job.

lines.text: Hi everyone, thanks for coming.
Today I’m going to talk about working at an animal shelter.
I want to start by saying that animal shelters are always looking for people to work for them – there are so many animals to look after!

For example, in the summer of 2018, the RSPCA – that’s the Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals – got around 20,000 calls about abandoned animals – animals that are left because people don’t want them.
That’s one every six minutes!
Anyway, let me talk about the advantages of working at a shelter.
By the way, there are more advantages than disadvantages.
First of all, you know that you are doing a good thing and you’re making sure the animals get all the care they need.
It’s a fantastic feeling to see an animal find a home, even though it is a lot of hard work to get an animal ready in the first place, especially those that have survived in difficult places.
Luckily, not all animals that come to us have suffered abuse.
On the contrary, their owners loved and cared for them, but had to give them up because they were no longer able to look after them.
It’s very sad, but we’re working very hard to find them good homes.
Furthermore, working at a shelter is good for your health, too.
It’s a fact that spending time with animals helps you feel less stressed.
Some universities in the UK actually use animals during exams to help students with stress.
And a number of airlines let passengers travel with their pets to help with the anxiety of flying.
Connecting with animals has a positive effect on your mood, helps you to be more relaxed and happier.

Another point is that you get to know the animals over a long period of time, which is important for people who want to take an animal home – you can tell them about the animal’s character and any training it needs.
Finally, you see them go to a good home – you have done all you can to help, you know they are going to a place where they will be safe and looked after.
However, working at a shelter has some disadvantages, too.
Knowing about the abuse the animals suffered, and the conditions they lived in before can make you feel unhappy.
It can also be very difficult to see an animal leave the shelter, especially one that has become your friend.
In most cases, it’s the last time you will see these animals.
Another disadvantage is more to do with the number of animals that are here.
This is certainly a problem in the shelter where I work.
We receive more animals than we can handle, and we work hard to make more space for them all the time.
Crowded places make animals anxious and disease can also be an issue.
That’s why we need more people!
To sum up, working at an animal shelter has both pros and cons, but it’s a very rewarding job.
It doesn’t only benefit your welfare, it benefits the welfare of all the animals in the shelter, too.

lines.text: Good morning.
Today I’m going to talk to you about the option of using our oceans to provide us with the energy we need for the future.
For a long time, we’ve used the ocean for two things: travel and food.
But now people are thinking of using the ocean to provide another resource: energy.
This makes a lot of sense because oceans cover 70 percent of the Earth.
Oceans can give us clean energy forever, not like fossil fuels which are limited and will soon run out.
Could this be a solution to the climate crisis?
We’ll have to wait and see …
Now, how do we get energy from the ocean?
Firstly, we can use waves, which are the rise and fall of the ocean, to run a generator – that’s a machine that makes electricity.
As the wave moves, it makes energy.
The bigger the wave, the more energy it has.
We can also use energy from waves to make air go through another type of machine, a turbine, to make electricity, too.
But some people correctly say that waves are not a good alternative energy source because they aren’t always the same size and they travel at different speeds.
Also, we can only use some areas of the ocean because most areas don’t get big waves, not big enough to produce the energy people need anyway.
However, we can also use tides.
Tides are when the ocean moves towards and away from the land (caused by the pull of the moon and the sun), and they are another source of energy.
We can make electricity from their movement by using power plants called ‘barrages’.
Barrages are like big walls built across rivers where they join the sea.
The barrage catches water at high tide and then lets it out at low tide through turbines to make electricity.
One of the benefits of using tides is that we know when they are going to happen, which is twice a day.
Yet we can’t predict how they will move, and barrages are only useful in places where there is a big difference between high and low tides.
Very few places have this big difference, which means that energy production is not reliable.
Barrages also cause environmental issues.
They can damage wildlife in the area, like birds.
They are also not very nice to look at and are not a benefit to people who live far from the ocean.
To sum up, the ocean’s mechanical energy, which is how the water in the ocean moves, can provide a lot of power.
In fact, scientists believe that the world’s waves and tides can make twice the amount of energy we produce now.
However, using the ocean’s mechanical energy also has a lot of disadvantages: it is expensive, not very efficient and it can cause environmental problems.

lines.text: My name’s Freda Robinson, and I write a blog about travel trends.
I’m going to look at a couple of recent trends in flight travel.
Has anyone in the audience been on a very long flight?
I thought so.
You probably noticed that these flights are longer than ever.
There is now a direct flight from London to Perth in Australia, for example.
It takes 17 hours – an extreme amount of time to be sitting on an airplane.
And that isn’t the longest flight!
Do you know what the longest flight is?
Well, it’s from Singapore to New York and it takes 19 hours.
Would you want to be on a plane for 19 hours to avoid changing planes two or three times?
I know I would … Direct flights are more convenient because you buy one ticket, fly with one airline, and you save time by not having to queue at two or three security points.
Also, you don’t have to wait around for your flight to board and take off.
I think long direct flights will be more common in the future as airlines have started focusing their attention both on safety and comfort.
Planes now have higher ceilings, better seats and bigger windows.
But you are still on a plane for 17−19 hours.
What are the airlines trying to do about this?
Well, Boom, an American start-up company, are making supersonic planes.
They want to reduce the flight between LA and Sydney from 15 hours to 7, and the flight from San Francisco to Tokyo from 11 to just 5 hours.
I believe there will be a serious change in long-distance travel when these planes become available.
Tickets might be expensive at first, but prices will go down when more airlines join in.
Moving on to another trend now.
Who here knows what FOMO is?
Young people, people born between 1981 and 1996 – called ‘millennials’ – probably know: fear of missing out.
But what does FOMO have to do with flight trends?
Well, it’s to do with independent travellers who want to experience new things.
Things their friends haven’t done yet.
And a lot of millennials are making travel choices based on social media, especially Instagram.
These types of travellers are looking for one-of-a-kind experiences, and airlines are trying to take advantage of this.
Experts say that about 40% of travellers under 33 years old are checking the ‘instagrammability’ of their holiday destinations, as they want something cool to share on social media.
This means airlines are increasing the number of destinations we can fly to and they are making it easier to get there, too.
So some of the ways the travel industry is changing are more direct flights with longer flight times, airlines’ attempts to reduce these and an increase in unusual destinations.
If you want to check out more travel trends, then visit my blog at …

lines.text: On this week’s podcast, I’ll be talking about a festival close to my heart: Dongzhi.
And in particular, the dumpling, a type of traditional Chinese food!
I’m from China.
That’s why this festival is a special event for me.
To understand this celebration, first you have to know about the winter solstice, which is when Dongzhi takes place.
The winter solstice is the shortest day of the year.
This means that after it, the days start to get longer, and the nights get shorter.
The day of the solstice changes every year, but for people in the northern parts of the world, it’s usually around the 21st of December (for those of you in the south, it’s around 20th June).
Dongzhi means ‘the extreme of winter’ and it shows the light winning over the dark.
Personally, I don’t really like winter, but for me, Dongzhi is one of the best things about it.
Due to the nature of our modern world, families don’t get the opportunity to spend much time together anymore.
They work in different cities or countries.
It seems to me that Dongzhi is an occasion to bring families together; a time when different generations can interact with one another.
And one thing is certain – all families will eat the most famous Chinese comfort food there is: tangyuan.
I love these sweet dumplings, and they remind me of my childhood.
Tangyuan are sweet and round, and they are about the size of a table tennis ball.
The traditional way of making them is to fill them with sesame seeds or red beans.
Then they are boiled (you can fry them too) and served in a sweet soup.
This is the way they taste best.
Their round shape is to show a coming together – suitable for when a family gets together, right?
A little history about these delicious dumplings then.
People say tangyuan are over 1,000 years old and they come from the time of the Tang Dynasty.
People back then began eating a ball of rice, sesame seeds, fat, and sugar.
They’ve had several names over the centuries, but during the twentieth century they became tangyuan.
This means ‘round balls in soup’.
I think that it’s quite a boring name for a food with such long history!
During Dongzhi, the dumplings, which are usually white, are coloured red or pink.
The reason for this is that they bring people good luck.
For a lot of older Chinese people, Dongzhi is an anniversary.
They believe people become a year older on Dongzhi rather than on their birthdays!
People also believe that if you eat two tangyuan, you will be lucky, and that a married person should leave two in the bowl, so their wishes come true!
But I’m not convinced.
I don’t really believe in superstitions, but it doesn’t matter, it’s nice to see that some traditions aren’t dying out …

lines.text: Host: On today’s show we’re going to talk about veganism.
Vegans, for those who don’t know, are people who choose not to eat or use any animal products.
It seems that more and more people are going vegan because it’s healthy and possibly fashionable.
There is no doubt that the number of people reducing the animal products they eat, whether it’s meat, cheese or eggs, has gone up in the past few years.
The number of vegans in the UK, for example, increased by 360% between 2006 and 2018.
But is it good for you?
Let’s try and find out.
With me is Clark Martin, a successful food blogger who is also a vegan.
Should I become a vegan, Clark?
Clark: Well, what do you think?
Should you keep eating meat and destroy your body and the planet at the same time?
It’s common knowledge that veganism has a lot of health benefits.
We eat a lot of fruit, vegetables, nuts and seeds as part of our diet, and stay away from fats, eggs and milk products which increase the risk of heart disease and certain types of cancer.
There is no question that being a vegan is better for you.
Host: Well, researchers would agree with you.
There are studies showing that vegans are less likely to be overweight and have heart disease.
I’ve also read somewhere that veganism reduces stress – not sure if that’s true.
However, one of the issues with being vegan is that you don’t get all the vitamins that you need, especially vitamin B12, which helps make blood and keeps the brain healthy.
Everyone knows that vitamin B12 is common in meat, fish and eggs, but not in plants.
Clark: [being sarcastic] Well, that’s just fantastic.
I can’t get B12.
Most people think that we all have vitamin problems, but again, this is just not true.
We get most of our vitamins from the food we eat, but we also take tablets.
The problem is that many people go vegan and think, ‘OK, now I’m much healthier!’ But before you go vegan you need to do a bit of research into what food groups you should eat and how often.
Host: Speaking of studies, here’s another one that says vegans have a lower risk of heart disease, but a higher risk of other serious diseases.
It also says that vegans have a higher risk of breaking their bones.
What do you think about that?
Clark: All vegans are weak, right?
Listen, studies compare us with meat eaters and look for differences.
It’s a fact that vegans are in better health, but there may be other health differences that have nothing to do with the diet.
All I’m saying is that going vegan makes you feel better.
I have more energy, and my concentration and performance have improved a lot.
Why don’t you learn a few recipes and try it for yourself?
Host: Maybe I’ll do that!

lines.text: Hello and welcome to the lecture!
Do you know what a happy accident is?
It’s when something happens that isn’t planned and turns out to be good for everyone.
This happens to scientists quite a lot and they have made some important discoveries as a result.
Some of these you may already know about, but perhaps you don’t know that some were happy accidents.
I’d like to start by talking about some surprising numbers.
Experts say that between 30 and 50 percent of the things that scientists discover aren’t planned.
But the important thing is that the scientist realizes it is valuable.
So, let’s have a look at some of these happy accidents.
First, we’ll discuss the discovery of a very important kind of medicine: antibiotics.
In 1928 Alexander Fleming was cleaning his laboratory after a holiday when he found a dish of bacteria that he had left out.
But he noticed that something had killed the bacteria on it, something he called penicillin.
After more research, he found that it could kill other bacteria and didn’t hurt animals.
Fleming wasn’t able to produce large quantities of penicillin, but he published his research in one of the medical journals.
Oxford University scientists Howard Florey and Ernst Chain studied penicillin some more and after a lot of research they developed the first antibiotic in 1942.
Next, let’s look at the X-ray.
In 1895, Wilhelm Conrad Röntgen, a physicist, was doing an experiment with something called a cathode ray tube – a long pipe filled with a special gas, similar to a modern light bulb.
When he put electricity into the tube, it lit up.
Then he decided to put black paper around it and noticed a green coloured light coming from a chemical close by.
Röntgen realized that the cathode ray tube was sending out a new type of light and he discovered this light could go through skin, but not bones or metal!
He called the technology X-rays because he didn’t really know what they were!
Röntgen won a Nobel Prize in physics in 1901 for his discovery.
Now, I’d like to mention a product I’m sure you all know: plastic.
Leo Hendrik Baekeland invented the first kind of plastic in 1907.
Baekeland was looking for something to replace the main ingredient in wood polish called shellac, which comes from an insect.
People used this to protect wood and other things, but it was very expensive.
Baekeland mixed a lot of things together and then heated them up, but he didn’t find what he was looking for.
Instead, he created something that didn’t melt when it got hot or break when someone hit it.
Yes, he discovered plastic, a material you can see all around you right now, by accident!
Are there any questions?
OK, let’s look at a few more …

lines.text: Interviewer: We’re back.
Welcome to today’s programme.
Our guest today is Monica Cordova, who worked as a model and is now a writer.
She’s here to tell us why we shouldn’t focus on buying clothes and instead we should swap them, that is give them to someone else and get different clothes back in return.
That is interesting – a model telling us not to buy clothes.
Thanks for being here, Monica.
Monica: Great to be here.
Interviewer: So, why aren’t you buying clothes?
I do admire you for it, but I don’t quite understand it.
Please explain.
Monica: I haven’t bought clothes for many years.
As you know, I was a model and sometimes I wore around 70 dresses a day.
Most of them were then thrown away, which shocked me.
So I decided to stop modelling and start writing about it instead.
Did you know that the fashion industry produces ten percent of all the pollution in the air?
Interviewer: Wow.
It does seem a lot for an industry you don’t normally think about as a cause of pollution.
Monica: Absolutely.
It’s more than the ship and airplane industries produce.
That gives you an idea of how bad it is.
I have noticed that the number of fashion seasons and shows has increased, too.
This makes us feel we never have enough, which is what the fashion industry wants us to feel, so we buy more.
Sure, you look unique, but at what cost?
In Europe, the average amount of clothes we buy has increased by 40 percent.
Here’s another thing.
Cotton needs a lot of water.
It takes 2,700 litres of water to produce a single T-shirt.
It takes 10,000 litres to make a pair of jeans.
It’s shocking!
Interviewer: I agree – that is shocking.
Wow.
So, what are you doing about this?
Monica: Well, I've started up a number of swap shops around the country.
Basically, you bring the things you don’t wear or don’t need anymore.
It doesn’t matter what the type, style or brand of clothing is.
As long as the item isn’t dirty or damaged, you can come into the shop and change it for something else.
You don’t have to buy anything.
It means we use our resources – clothes in this case – for as long as possible.
Interviewer: Is there anything you’ve noticed about the clothes you receive?
Monica: What I’ve noticed – and it’s not very surprising, really – is that most of the clothes people bring in are new or almost new, and have the latest designs.
The other thing is the amount.
We get bags and bags of clothes.
Interviewer: Do you think that this will hurt the fashion industry?
Monica: No, they are a huge industry.
Our shops are a way of telling the fashion manufacturers what changes they need to make.
I don’t think they will listen to us, but I’m not going to stop doing this.
Interviewer: Thanks, Monica.
This was really interesting.
I like shopping, but I am going to change my shopping habits from now on!

lines.text: Thank you for coming tonight.
Let’s start with some quick questions for everyone.
When was the last time you took out money from a cash machine?
When was the last time you made a payment with cash?
In other words, when did you last use coins and notes to buy something?
Probably not for some time.
It seems that every day more and more shops are making the decision to have customers use cards or mobile payment.
Some people think this means that we won’t use cash anymore: the end of cash they call it.
Personally, I’m not convinced for a couple of reasons.
First of all, we’ve used physical money, like coins and notes, for a very, very long time – some coins are thousands of years old.
It is easy to carry, and it’s very reliable.
You can use it anywhere, whether you want to buy a bar of chocolate at the corner shop or do your weekly shopping in a big supermarket chain.
Using cash is also a way of keeping your money private.
That is, you can use it without anyone checking on you.
Bitcoin, a digital kind of money, which is managed by people and not the government, is similar to cash in this way.
But it isn’t safe and it’s difficult to use.
People use credit and debit cards all the time, but they immediately connect what you buy to who you are.
To use online payments, you have to have an app and an account.
To put it another way, technology doesn’t have the secret thing that cash has.
Cash is private and I like that.
However, the main reason I don’t agree that this is the end of cash, is our relationship with it.
People look at coins and notes in a different way from electronic money.
They both have the same value, but because you can see cash and hold it, it makes it feel like you own it more.
In fact, when I have cash, I spend it in a more responsible way; when I buy things with my card, I use it without thinking.
Humans have a strong relationship with coins and notes, so I don’t think we’d be able to give up cash easily anyway.
Cash just feels safer, and this is something that digital money can’t offer at the moment.
If there’s some kind of financial crisis or a natural disaster when there’s no power, I’m sure most of you would rather have the money in your hand, right?
I know I would.
To sum up, I don’t think that the end of cash is happening soon.
I just don’t see the other options as better—for now anyway—and our relationship with cash, means it’ll be in our pockets for some time to come.
